compliance_failure.account: The recorder conformance finished within the preparation allowance, but the external supervisor was prepared afterwards. Preparation therefore exceeded the allowance before the broad sample started; the developer should have stopped instead of starting it.

approved_measurement_decision.stop_applied: The broad command exited nonzero. No other planned scenario ran and no sample was repeated. The command completed before its external deadline; no measurement remains running.

conditions.hardware: darwin/arm64, 16 logical CPUs reported by Python os.cpu_count; CPU model and physical-core count were not collected.
conditions.effective_parallelism: GOFLAGS and GOMAXPROCS were unset. No -p or -parallel override was supplied. The darwin host reports 16 logical CPUs, implying the normal Go defaults of up to 16 test cases per binary and up to 16 build/package jobs; the actual runtime values were not instrumented and are not independently measured.
conditions.cache_condition: Existing harness-configured shared compiled-object cache reused; -count=1 prevented Go test-result cache replay. No cache was flushed and no cold-cache comparison was attempted.
conditions.machine_activity: Other users or harness runs were not controlled. No synthetic saturation was created.

failed_sample.first_failure_message: pipeline_test.go:3618: cleanup could not list worktrees: exit status 125:
failed_sample.failure_attribution: The measurement wrapper generated exit 125. This attempt does not demonstrate a regression in Yoyodyne or Git.

recording_failure.mechanism: The wrapper used records/<pid>-start.json and records/<pid>-end.json opened exclusively. The host process-ID range wrapped during the fork-heavy sample. A reused PID encountered an existing start record and returned 125 before calling real Git.
evidence: All saved wrapper completion records have real Git exits 0, 1, 2, 128 or 129; none has exit 125.
Test output contains 375 diagnostic lines naming exit status 125.
Opening an already saved PID start path with exclusive-create reproduces FileExistsError (Errno 17).
The active scenario file remained present and scratch remained writable.
recording_failure.certainty: PID reuse is the supported explanation for the recorder refusal. The wrapper did not log errno on its rejected opens, so the specific refused path for each failure is not recorded.
recording_failure.required_correction: Allocate a unique invocation identifier independent of PID (for example mkstemp), carry it through start and end records, and use PID only as metadata. A write refusal must include its errno and path and invalidate the sample visibly.
recording_failure.preflight_gap: Five successful behavior cases did not test identifier reuse or failure behavior. The wrapper passed a small preflight and then changed Git exit behavior under the actual finite suite.
recording_failure.deadline_gap: The supervisor enumerates descendants with ps only if a deadline expires. A post-run diagnostic established that spawning ps is refused here (Operation not permitted). The deadline branch was not entered, but it cannot be accepted as reliable descendant/process-group cleanup in a later sample.
recording_failure.required_deadline_correction: Track the measurement process groups as they are created, or use another supported supervisor whose deadline and child reaping are verified in this sandbox before starting measurement. Do not change production or test-binary timeouts.
recording_failure.cleanup_evidence: The supervisor reaped /usr/bin/time, both Go test packages produced terminal events, and all surviving wrapper starts have waited/reaped Git children and matching end records. A whole-machine process inventory could not be checked because ps was refused.

baseline_fields.qualification: Not measured reliably, never zero. The scratch analyzer also infers some fixture phases from source order; its phase rules were not fully audited. Its raw per-test rankings and origin estimates are deliberately not accepted or copied here.

reproduction_and_raw_evidence.overlay_inputs: overlay.json and overlay/; source-hashes.json records the original source hashes.
reproduction_and_raw_evidence.instrumentation_scope: Scratch-only C PATH wrapper delegates to the resolved Git binary, strips its own PATH entry for Git children and waits with wait4. Runtime call stacks and exact TempDir owners are added through Go overlays. Direct test Git helpers, fake forge Git calls and OSProcessRunner commands are tagged; internal Git descendants count only within their parent invocation resource usage.
reproduction_and_raw_evidence.overhead: No statistically supported overhead estimate was collected. Each recorded Git invocation adds one wrapper fork, two exclusive record writes and call-stack serialization; the attempt timings include that overhead. The C child rusage excludes wrapper CPU, while whole-command rusage includes it.
